notes.title: UPDATE 2.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!!
[b]I've updated the demo with some small changes.[/b]
Post-processing has been improved so as to give some depth to the graphics.
Most of the particles have been changed so they weigh less on the CPU and more on the GPU improving the overall performance.
Some bugs have been fixed and the gaming experience has been improved by calibrating some factors such as movement speed, robot battery consumption etc etc.
Moving on to the most important new features, a new type of attack has been added, the [u]flying fists![/u] 
Such an attack can be performed as an "end" move after two consecutive melee strikes.
The upgrade system has been redone from scratch. It is now more like a talent branch. 
New upgrades have been added such as bullet reflection, the ability to recharge the battery while taking damage, and the ability to perform critical attacks.
Each skill has its own in-game explanation.

[b]It is still an incomplete demo and to be fixed in many aspects. 
Let me know what you think, if there are any bugs or improvements you would like to see.[/b]
[b]
Greetings from TribanzDev[/b]

notes.title: Demo Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
In this update some new game mechanics have been implemented and as a result there has been a redesign of the story mode levels.
One story mode level and one arcade mode level have been added.
Below is a list of the additions:

[list]
[*] Game physics with moveable objects.
[*] A new weapon the tesla ray!
[*] Two new special attacks the time slower and the portable black hole.
[*] New story map : Suburbia where you will have to “find yourself.”
[*] New arcade map : Bridge Defense. 
[/list]

Until the next update! 

TribanzDev

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Demo Update[/b][/h1]

Hello everyone!!!

The demo has been updated with new features.

The weapons have been modified and made more useful and differentiated.
[list]
[*][b]Energy Laser:[/b] basic attack, added secondary attack ( hold down “Shoot” button)
[*][b]Machine gun: [/b] burst mode, added overheating if firing too long bursts. Related upgrade is modified that increases the amount of bullets fired before the weapon overheats.
[*][b]R-Fluid:[/b] weapon that causes initial damage and damage over time to enemies. Modified relative upgrade that increases damage over time of attack.
[*][b]Plasma Balls:[/b] new weapon designed for close attack. Pressing the “Shoot” button accelerates the spheres, which on impact express their full damage only if they reach maximum speed. Upgrade adds an orb up to a maximum of 4.
[*][b]Missile:[/b] KabOOm! Related upgrade increases the cruise speed of the missile.
[*][b]Bombs/Mines:[/b] pressing the “Granade” key allows you to throw hand grenades. Holding down the key places mines. The related upgrade creates three more bombs upon explosion.
[*][b]Shield Overload:[/b] Overloading the shield causes severe damage to everything around you but causes the immediate loss of the entire shield bar.
[/list]

An Arcade mode level has been added where you will face 19 waves of enemies and kill the final boss. 
In arcade mode you will have all weapons and power-ups unlocked giving you a way to test the game more thoroughly.

Thanks to all.

 
[b]Triban Henry
TribanzDev[/b]
